steps.name: update-frontend-dependencies
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "f4afaff647ad5ceaf55d21e8f17a2ee06042b2c7"
cd frontend
npm ci
npm install --save-dev vitest@^5.0.1 @vitejs/plugin-react@^4.7.0 typescript@^5.9.3 vite@^6.4.3
npm update
npm audit fix
npm install --save-dev prettier@3.8.4
cd ..
git diff --check
changed=$(git diff --name-only | sort)
test "$changed" = $'frontend/package-lock.json\nfrontend/package.json'

verify_steps.name: frontend-security-and-tests
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd frontend
npm audit --audit-level=moderate
npm run format:check
npm run lint
npm run knip
npm test
npm run build
cd ..
git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-project-quality
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-deps-venv-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
npx playwright install chromium
cd ..
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" make quality
git diff --check
changed=$(git diff --name-only | sort)
test "$changed" = $'frontend/package-lock.json\nfrontend/package.json'
